component.name: alibaba-eventbridge
component.title: Alibaba EventBridge
component.description: Publish events to Alibaba Cloud EventBridge.
component.label: cloud,messaging

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeOperation.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. This header replaces the operation option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the operation option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventBusName.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventBusName.description: The name of the event bus for a JSON text or Map body. This header replaces the eventBusName option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the eventBusName option. The key eventBusName of a Map body replaces this header.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSource.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSource.description: The event source for a JSON text or Map body. The value must be a URI. This header replaces the eventSource option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the eventSource option. The key eventSource or source of a Map body replaces this header.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventType.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventType.description: The event type for a JSON text or Map body. This header replaces the eventType option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the eventType option. The key eventType or type of a Map body replaces this header.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSubject.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSubject.description: The event subject for a JSON text or Map body. This header replaces the eventSubject option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the eventSubject option. The key eventSubject or subject of a Map body replaces this header.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSour.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSour.description: Whether to check that the event bus exists and has a rule that matches the event source. The producer calls listEventBuses and listRules to check this. The producer also checks that each event source that allowedEventSources lists for the event bus matches a rule. This header replaces the validateEventSource option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the validateEventSource option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventType.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventType.description: Whether to check that the event bus exists and has a rule that matches the event source and event type. The producer calls listEventBuses and listRules to check this. The producer also checks that each event type that allowedEventSources lists for the event bus matches a rule. This header replaces the validateEventType option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the validateEventType option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSpec.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSpec.description: Whether to check the keys specversion and id of a Map body. The value of specversion must be 1.0, and the value of id must not be blank. This header replaces the validateEventSpec option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the validateEventSpec option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeAllowedEventSourc.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeAllowedEventSourc.description: The event sources and event types that the producer allows on each event bus. The value must be a Map, a Collection or a String as in the allowedEventSources option. This header replaces the allowedEventSources option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the allowedEventSources option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSourceCacheT.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSourceCacheT.description: The time in milliseconds for which the producer caches the result of listEventBuses and listRules for an event bus. Only used when validateEventSource or validateEventType is true. Use 0 or less to cache nothing. This header replaces the eventSourceCacheTtl option. If this header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces the eventSourceCacheTtl option.

CamelAlibabaEventBridgeRequestId.label: producer
CamelAlibabaEventBridgeRequestId.description: The request ID that EventBridge returns in the response to the operation. The producer sets it, unless the exchange fails.

producerIn.description: The event to publish: the JSON text of the data of the event, as text, or as bytes, a stream or a file read in the charset of the exchange (UTF-8 by default), with the source, the type and the bus from the options or headers; a Map of the event fields, such as eventSource, eventType and eventData, where a Map or a POJO as data is serialized to JSON; a CloudEvent of the Alibaba SDK; or a List of these for a batch. Another POJO or no body fails

producerOut.description: A Map with the requestId, the failedEntryCount, the resourceOwnerAccountId and the entryList of the response, with the request id in the CamelAlibabaEventBridgeRequestId header too. An event that EventBridge rejects does not fail the exchange: check failedEntryCount

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeOperation header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

allowedEventSources.label: producer
allowedEventSources.description: The event sources and event types that the producer allows on each event bus. Written as JSON or as bus blocks in the form bus1[source1 = type1,type2] | bus2[source2 = type3]. Semicolons separate the event sources of one event bus. A value in the form source1 = type1,type2 applies to the event bus that eventBusName sets for the exchange. If eventBusName is not set, it applies to every event bus. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeAllowedEventSources header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. If none of the three is set, the producer allows every event bus, event source and event type.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of EventBridge, which is a host name without http:// or https://. The region option does not determine the endpoint, so this option is required. Not used when the eventBridgeClient option is set or autowired.

eventBusName.description: The name of the event bus for a JSON text or Map body. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventBusName header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. The key eventBusName of a Map body replaces the three. One of the three is required for a JSON text body, or a Map body without that key.

eventSource.description: The event source for a JSON text or Map body. The value must be a URI. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSource header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. The key eventSource or source of a Map body replaces the three. One of the three is required for a JSON text body, or a Map body without that key.

eventSubject.description: The event subject for a JSON text or Map body. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSubject header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. The key eventSubject or subject of a Map body replaces the three. If neither the three nor that key is set, the producer adds no event subject to the event.

eventType.description: The event type for a JSON text or Map body. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventType header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option. The key eventType or type of a Map body replaces the three. One of the three is required for a JSON text body, or a Map body without that key.

region.description: The region ID of EventBridge, for example cn-hangzhou. The producer sends it in the HTTP header x-eventbridge-regionId of each request. Not used when the eventBridgeClient option is set or autowired.

validateEventSource.label: producer
validateEventSource.description: Whether to check that the event bus exists and has a rule that matches the event source. The producer calls listEventBuses and listRules to check this. The producer also checks that each event source that allowedEventSources lists for the event bus matches a rule. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSource header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

validateEventSpec.label: producer
validateEventSpec.description: Whether to check the keys specversion and id of a Map body. The value of specversion must be 1.0, and the value of id must not be blank. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventSpec header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

validateEventType.label: producer
validateEventType.description: Whether to check that the event bus exists and has a rule that matches the event source and event type. The producer calls listEventBuses and listRules to check this. The producer also checks that each event type that allowedEventSources lists for the event bus matches a rule. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeValidateEventType header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

eventSourceCacheTtl.label: producer,advanced
eventSourceCacheTtl.description: The time in milliseconds for which the producer caches the result of listEventBuses and listRules for an event bus. Only used when validateEventSource or validateEventType is true. Use 0 or less to cache nothing. The CamelAlibabaEventBridgeEventSourceCacheTtl header replaces this option for a request that the producer sends. If that header is not set, an exchange property of the same name replaces this option.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

eventBridgeClient.label: advanced
eventBridgeClient.description: To use a custom com.aliyun.eventbridge.EventBridgeClient. The producer sends its requests with this client, and the region, endpoint, accessKey, secretKey and serviceKeys options are not used. If no client is set or autowired, the Camel endpoint creates an EventBridgeClient from these options. It creates this client when the producer processes its first message.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The AccessKey ID of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to EventBridge. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the eventBridgeClient option is set or autowired.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The AccessKey secret of the AccessKey pair for the requests that the producer sends to EventBridge. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used, and one of the two is required. Not used when the eventBridgeClient option is set or autowired.

serviceKeys.label: security
serviceKeys.description: The AccessKey pair as an org.apache.camel.component.alibaba.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey is the AccessKey ID and its secretKey is the AccessKey secret. Each of the two is used when the option of the same name is not set. Not used when the eventBridgeClient option is set or autowired.
